map.v_x = 20×cos30 = 17.32 m/s，v_y = 20×sin3: v_x = 20×cos30 = 17.32 m/s, v_y = 20×sin30 = 10 m/s. Horizontal uniform motion, vertical under gravity.
map.vₓ=v·cos60°=40×0.5=20.000 m/s；v_y=v·sin6: vₓ=v·cos60°=40×0.5=20.000 m/s; v_y=v·sin60°=40×0.866=34.641 m/s. Ignoring air resistance, the horizontal component stays constant throughout.
map.水平不受力匀速、竖直受重力匀变，拆开后各自独立再用运动学公式，是弹道标准做法。: Horizontal has no force (uniform), vertical has gravity (uniformly variable); separated, each is independent and kinematics formulas apply — the standard ballistic practice.
map.为什么水平分量一直不变、竖直分量却在变？: Why does the horizontal component stay constant while the vertical changes?
map.忽略空气阻力时水平方向没有受力（加速度为 0），所以 vₓ 恒定；竖直方向始终受: Ignoring air resistance, the horizontal direction has no force (acceleration 0), so vₓ is constant; the vertical direction is always under gravity, v_y decreases about 9.8 m/s each second, reaching 0 at the apex then increasing reversed. This tool gives the components at the instant of launch.
map.抛体初速度正交分解：vₓ = v·cosθ、vᵧ = v·sinθ（θ 仰角按度: Orthogonal decomposition of initial projectile velocity: vₓ = v·cosθ, vᵧ = v·sinθ (θ is entered in degrees and multiplied by π÷180 for the calculation); linked values: resultant direction = atan2(vᵧ,vₓ)×180÷π (°, the elevation angle), component ratio = vₓ ÷ (vᵧ||1) (1 used as the denominator when vᵧ is 0). Validation: no strict validation; blank values fall back to 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; the two components are equal at θ=45°, the horizontal component dominates below 45° and the vertical one above 45°.
